producer_report.summary: `athena --version` and `-V` now print the package version, the first seven characters of the build's source commit, and `, dirty` when the build is dirty, e.g. `athena 0.1.0 (abc1234, dirty)`. The text comes from a new `wiring::version_string()`, which formats `build_info()`; main.rs wires it into clap's `version` attribute. A build with no commit prints `athena 0.1.0 (unknown, dirty)`. `build_info()`, xtask, setup and job records are unchanged, and no build.rs or non-Rust files were added. Four unit tests in wiring.rs cover clean, dirty, unknown and full-hash cases. A binary test in tests/binary.rs runs `--version` and `-V` and checks the version, a hex commit or `unknown`, and the flag. docs/architecture.md's athena-cli row now mentions `--version`. Checks: fmt, clippy with warnings denied, and the full `cargo test --locked` all pass. The run with the build variables set was not done: the Bash policy denied the `env` prefix, and I did not route around it.

checks_run.note: 5 unit tests and 6 binary tests pass, including the new version tests.
Run after the last source edit.
Plain build, no build variables. Printed `athena 0.1.0 (unknown, dirty)`.
Full workspace, including xtask policy tests (dependency direction, enforcement map, personal-data scan). All pass; live tests are ignored, as before.

open_issues: Acceptance check 1 was not run on a binary built with ATHENA_BUILD_COMMIT and ATHENA_BUILD_DIRTY set. The formatting is covered by unit tests, and the wiring from `build_info()` is unchanged, but the end-to-end run is not verified. The verifier should run it.
The binary test accepts any hex commit of at least seven characters, or `unknown`. It does not check the commit against a known value. This is deliberate, because the test build sets no variable.
mistakes: The first `version_string()` returned `String`, which clap rejects. Fixed by caching a `&'static str` in a `OnceLock`.
I did not check clap's accepted `version` types against Cargo.lock before writing the code. The compile error caught it.
learnings: clap 4.6.7's `version` attribute accepts only `&'static str`, not `String`, so the formatted string is cached in a `OnceLock` in wiring.rs.
xtask passes the full `git rev-parse HEAD` hash in ATHENA_BUILD_COMMIT, so the formatter shortens it to seven characters.
An xtask policy test parses the architecture doc's crate table. Only the Responsibility column changed there, and the test passes.
Bash in this job is limited to a policy list. `env VAR=... cargo ...` is denied by the PreToolUse hook.
desires: A permitted way to run cargo with build environment variables set (the `env` prefix is denied), so acceptance check 1 can be run on the binary.
